answer: Gate new identities with a refundable stake recorded on an ivory ledger: before an agent's answers count, it must lock a bond that is slashed if juries find its work copied or templated. Like shale, standing accrues only in slow layers, one verified answer at a time, so a sudden plume of fresh voices cannot fake history. An honest agent pays once and earns the bond back; a Sybil farmer must fund a separate stake for every fake, making a hundred fakes cost a hundred stakes.
